appearance.scope: Retain Phase 4 colour/normal/Bedford/opal interpretations; add selected B linear roughness derivatives for InteriorGranite, MilfordGranite, Travertine with unit multipliers. No measured historic surface is claimed.
appearance.method: Decode sRGB to linear; normalize each source channel by its spatial mean; apply contrast about that mean and multiply by the target linear palette; clip to0..1; resize in linear light; encode sRGB once.
appearance.baseColourFactors: Original material-family factors are accounted for in the colour-derivative application reports. The authored Bedford maps already contain their target mean linear colour and use a unit baseColorFactor, avoiding double tinting.
appearance.lightingLimitation: This checkpoint retains all six Phase 4 atlases and static probes. New ceiling UV packing and the fresh vault bake remain pending; source checks do not establish their runtime acceptance.
appearance.interiorGraniteFinish: Selected bounded B range 0.30–0.48 in linear data replaces the earlier 0.50 multiplier; original CC0 grain remains, with no calibrated historic roughness sample.
